Curry Debal.note: Chicken sausages stated with wheat and soy; candlenut read as tree_nuts (v12 safe reading); mustard seeds = mustard. No pork or alcohol, so halal by ingredients at a 'none' branch. The free white rice is the default; turmeric rice and bread roll are priced add-ons (not counted). Very spicy.

Pork Vindalho.note: Pork; mustard seeds. Vinegar, garlic, chilli, cumin add no allergen. Spicy.

Ikan Ambiler.note: Mackerel = fish; belacan = crustaceans. Brinjal, lemongrass, turmeric add nothing. Spicy.

Chicken Pong Teh.note: Taucheo = soy; dark soy sauce = soy + gluten. Gula melaka. Not spicy, no chilli named.

Seybak.note: Pork belly; dark soy sauce = soy + gluten. Not spicy.

Feng.note: Pork and offal; coriander, cumin, fennel and turmeric are not regulated allergens (fennel is not celery). Mildly spicy.

Beef Smoore.note: Dark soy = soy + gluten; Worcestershire = fish + gluten (rule i). No alcohol stated. Not spicy.

Ikan Chuan Chuan.note: Pomfret = fish; taucheo = soy; light soy = soy + gluten. Not spicy. Sold out.

Sambal Lada with Fried Fish.note: Ikan selar = fish; belacan in the sambal = crustaceans. Turmeric-fried, no flour stated. Very spicy.

Eurasian Fried Rice.note: Prawns; egg; light soy = soy + gluten. Not spicy.

Achar.note: Crushed peanuts and sesame seeds; no belacan or dried shrimp named; merchant tags vegan. Mildly spicy.

Debal Lunch Set.note: Union of its default parts: Curry Debal (wheat/soy sausages, candlenut, mustard seeds), white rice, Portuguese Egg Tart (butter pastry, eggs, milk, cream) and lime juice or iced lemon tea (both allergen-free). Very spicy from the curry.

Eurasian Big Breakfast.note: Eggs; chicken sausages with wheat and soy; buttered toast = gluten + milk. Baked beans and mushrooms add nothing. Halal by ingredients.

Debal Bread Bowl.note: Curry Debal (sausage wheat and soy, candlenut, mustard seeds) in a wheat loaf. Very spicy.

Seybak Bun.note: Pork belly; dark soy = soy + gluten; milk bun = milk + gluten. No egg stated. Not spicy.

Pang Susi.note: Flour, butter, egg dough; minced pork filling, so not vegetarian and not halal.

Portuguese Egg Tart.note: Butter pastry (wheat, butter); custard of eggs, milk, cream.

Sugee Cake.note: Semolina = wheat; butter; egg yolks; ground almonds. No brandy stated.

Cocada.note: Egg yolk. Coconut is not a tree nut or milk.

Sago Gula Melaka.note: Sago, palm sugar, coconut milk (not milk). The vanilla ice cream add-on is out and is not counted.

Christmas Fruit Cake.note: Flour, butter, eggs, almonds; rum = not halal, no allergen. Raisins and prunes, no sulphited fruit named.

Kopi.note: Condensed milk. No butter roast stated (rule o does not apply).

Tiger Beer.note: Barley malt = gluten; alcohol = not halal. Vegan as earlier lagers (v7 Asahi, v8 Tsingtao).

Port Wine.note: Grape wine (fortified) = sulphites, not halal (rule h). Fining agents (egg white, casein) are unstated, so vegan is not claimed; vegetarian kept.
